note: Version 4 (2026-11-18): the sheet is pulled from the spec binder for each patient (data/parts.json): the eyes, hands, port and speech rows take their normal and their fine line from the models the patient wears, and only what no model changes lives here. title names the patient; title_none heads the natural baseline shown between patients. The hands normal is filled with the limit of the patient's hands model. threshold is the house rule printed in the footer: this many broken lines mean drifting. Every drifting case must break at least this many (case_db checks it), and the record counts the player's own crosses against it. The count is advice: nothing scores it or stops a decision.
title: REFERENCE SHEET: {name}
